messages:
deploy-bot: starting rollout rl-2026-03-24-02 canary=8% -> scheduled step to 35% in 12m
anya: quick note 3 eu-west synth p95 for /generate up ~240ms from ~130ms, responses still 200s :thinking:
sam: grabbing gateway traces and auth client logs now
matt: auth header KV miss rate on gw-prod-4 spiked to ~6% (baseline ~0.8%), tail latency lines up
lucy: this release flipped routing.local_first=true and increased proxy conn pool per release notes
anya: synths show no 5xxs, just latency bump
triage-bot: INC-2026-060 created - postdeploy synth latency spike
sam: suggest pause automated ramp and pin /generate to previous variant v2.1.0 while we triage
anya: +1 on pause and pin
matt: agree, likely extra header lookups from local_first causing KV pressure
lucy: sample pin call:
```
POST /admin/routing/pin
{"route":"/generate","variant":"v2.1.0"}
```
sam: applied pin at 4615004400 (actor: sam) :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: routing pin applied to /generate -> v2.1.0
ops-bot: smoke-probe run (post-pin) -> p95=142ms p99=198ms status=ok
anya: latency back near baseline after pin, nice mitigation
matt: will keep canary at 8% for a 25m stability window, instrument auth client histograms for microbursts
sam: adding changelog note: "pinned /generate to v2.1.0 due to auth-KV miss spike when routing.local_first enabled; follow-up RFC-2026-88"
lucy: opened RFC-2026-88 to evaluate header prefetch, local cache warming, and client backpressure
anya: retrospective action: include a tiny preflight synthetic that exercises tenant-auth headers for routing changes
triage-bot: INC-2026-060 marked monitoring; awaiting stable signal
anya: thanks everyone, keep dashboards tight; close when green
